question: Does the frozen original Stage1 39-input information set separately predict both the SOXX cash opportunity and SOXL-minus-SOXX relative selection targets that account attribution found to be distinct failure terms? This tests receiver/task alignment, not a new external factor or strategy.

targets.cash_advantage_H5: negative sum of five next open-to-open SOXX log returns; positive means cash beats SOXX before trading costs. Reuse the saved credit-screen original-39 Ridge baseline by exact sign inversion of its prediction and target; no cash refit.
targets.SOXL_relative_H5: sum of five next open-to-open SOXL log returns minus the identical SOXX sum; no dividend or Tiered fee claim. Fit one fixed original-39-input Ridge(alpha=1) head.
targets.label_maturity: Fifth open-to-open return's saved Qlib return_available_at, strictly before training cutoff and held evaluation terminal; last four held source rows unknown, never filled.
targets.decision_clock: Original Stage1 signal date features before next session 09:46 action; no same-day 2023+ outcome in training.

model_and_controls.cash_head: reuse exact saved SimpleImputer(median)->StandardScaler->Ridge(alpha=1) original-39 baseline from the sealed credit information card; prediction and target both negated for cash advantage
model_and_controls.relative_head: one new SimpleImputer(median)->StandardScaler->Ridge(alpha=1) on original 39 in their frozen order
model_and_controls.each_control: constant training-mean forecast for that target; fixed before held read

per_target: full held MSE improvement over train-mean control positive
2024 and 2025 complete-year paired MSE improvements positive

stop: Require exact source bytes and cold NAS scoped readback of the reused cash model/prediction before constructing labels. If dates, label maturity, saved cash-target equality, feature order or full 3014/940 support fail, stop before fit. After one relative fit and two fixed bootstraps, failure of either head closes this dual-receiver version; no outcome-chosen mapping, threshold, horizon, sign, year or feature repair. A joint historical information pass would still require one separately frozen full Stage1-derived own-state 0bp Tiered account and all SOXX v2 gates, then 2/5bp and independent forward evidence.
